summary: Full e2e test of EdTech Ops Hub MVP. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed (dashboard, programs CRUD, sessions, calendar, clashes, meta, sow preview/download, attendance multipart). Frontend: 14/14 Playwright flows passed (dashboard metrics with red clash card, programs grid + add/edit/delete drawers, calendar 12 session blocks + clash banner + session-detail panel + prev/next month, SOW generate/preview/grand-total/download, attendance page loads, footer 'Engineered by Arya Ghai' on all 5 pages). MVP is in a shippable state.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'); should migrate to lifespan context manager. Non-blocking but emits DeprecationWarning.

allow_credentials=True paired with allow_origins=['*'] is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers ignore credentials. Works because app has no auth, but should be tightened or set allow_credentials=False.

ui_bugs.issue: Not disabled when required fields are empty (process button is enabled even with no tracker/teams file, no session name, no date). User must click and see backend 422 to know form is invalid. Should disable until tracker+teams+name+date are filled, or show inline validation.
Uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component. Inconsistent with the rest of the app's component library.

integration_issues.issue: After SOW download triggers 'Excel downloaded.' toast, navigating to Attendance page still shows the toast (visible top-right). Likely toast TTL > navigation time; consider clearing toasts on route change.

issues: Clean, consistent. Dark sidebar / light content / footer all render correctly. Clashes card uses red accent border + red number — clear visual hierarchy.

action_items: (Optional) Disable Attendance 'Process & Download' button until all required fields are filled, or add inline field-level validation messages.
(Optional) Replace native date input on Attendance with shadcn Calendar/DatePicker for UI consistency.
(Optional) Migrate FastAPI startup event to lifespan context manager.
(Optional) Clear toasts on route change so 'Excel downloaded' from SOW doesn't persist on Attendance.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~430 lines — still manageable but route handlers could be split into routers (dashboard.py, programs.py, calendar.py, sow.py, attendance.py) if growth continues.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in all find queries via projection {'_id': 0}. Good.
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) read without defaults — fail-fast. Good.
All endpoints prefixed with /api router. Good.
Pydantic models used for input validation on programs/sessions. Attendance uses Form()/File() validation (returns 422 on missing). Good.
data-testid coverage is excellent — every interactive control and key data display has one.
Clash detection algorithm is O(n^2) inside each (mentor,date) group — fine at current scale (12 sessions); add index/cap if dataset grows.
Attendance processor name-matching has 3-tier fallback (exact, all-tokens, first-name-uncertain) — solid for the use case.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth, app is open.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 4 programs / 12 sessions / 1 intentional clash (Manoj Ajmer overlapping today) on startup when programs collection is empty. Test created/deleted a TEST_UI_Program and TEST_Program_QA via UI and API — cleaned up successfully.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All MVP flows verified end-to-end. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py covers 14 cases including SOW xlsx download and attendance multipart upload with a synthesized UTF-16 tab-separated Teams export (helper _make_teams_csv). Frontend testids enumerated in: /app/frontend/src/{components/Sidebar.jsx, pages/*.jsx}. Key testids: metric-{programs,sessions,mentors,clashes}-value, sidebar-nav-{dashboard,attendance,calendar,programs,sow}, program-card, program-{name,client,code,owner,mentor}-input, program-save-btn, edit-program-btn, delete-program-btn, confirm-delete-btn, cal-{prev,next}-btn, cal-month-label, cal-session-block, clash-banner, clash-panel, clash-item, session-detail-panel, sow-{generate,download}-btn, sow-{preview,grand-total,subtotal,row}, attendance-{process,tracker-input,teams-input,session-name,session-date,threshold-slider,download,reset}-btn / -input, app-footer.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced; all suggested fixes are polish/UX improvements, not RCAs.
